reviews.text: We’ve been using A Better Pool Service for a while now. This is the second house we’ve used them at, my mom was the first to recommend them to me after I was constantly complaining about my last pool company. Making the switch was the best decision. They come out very fast every time I have an issue or concern with any equipment. If they don’t know the answer, they find someone who does. We especially love Lance, who comes out every week. Our pool is never cloudy or green and he never leaves even one leaf behind! They are all super friendly, even my 3 year old gets excited to go say hi to Lance when he is here. They go the extra mile. They sent out step by step instructions on what to do in case we lose power during the freeze. Lance took that step even further by sending out pictures for those of us who are more visual. I could go on and on about the fabulous customer service.
reviews.author: Morgan Beauregard

reviews.text:
"I've been using “A Better Pool Service” for 10+ years, and I couldn't be happier with their service. They are incredibly reliable, always arriving on time and completing the job efficiently. The team is professional and courteous, making every interaction pleasant. Their expertise is evident, as they handle my pool's unique needs with ease and always leave it amazingly clean. I appreciate their thoroughness and attention to detail, ensuring that no corner is left untouched.
Communication is another strong point; they keep me informed about any issues and upcoming maintenance schedules. The service is reasonably priced, offering great value. They've also been flexible with my schedule, accommodating last-minute changes without any hassle. I highly recommend their services to anyone looking for a top-notch pool cleaning experience!"

reviews.text:
My husband and I recently bought our first home, which came with a pool. We had absolutely no idea how a pool worked—how to maintain it, balance the chemicals, or keep it looking clean. Like most new pool owners, we first turned to Leslies, but that experience was a total disappointment. After calling around to several pool companies with no luck, I came across A Better Pool Service, and I’m so glad I did.

From the very beginning, their customer service stood out. They’re a family-owned company that truly cares, and when they came out to give us “pool school,” they were incredibly thorough and patient in walking us through every step. It quickly became clear that maintaining a pool was more than we could handle on our own, so we decided to hire them for weekly pool cleaning—and that was the best decision we could have made.

Our technician, Chris, has been wonderful. He not only explains everything clearly but also goes above and beyond to keep our pool in top shape. At one point, when our lack of experience caused the pool to turn green, Chris was able to restore it back to being crystal clear and sparkling again.

We couldn’t be happier with their service. If you’re looking for a trustworthy, reliable, and knowledgeable pool company, I highly recommend A Better Pool Service. They truly are amazing!
reviews.author: Michelle Alvarez Tostado

reviews.text: A better pool service is truly a better pool service, they are helpful and have decent prices, we had another company be extremely rude to us and annoyed with our request for a price quote since the owners had been using them they expected our business even though they treated us terribly and A Better Pool Service was a breath of fresh air, I know they are a smaller company and have shorter hours but well worth it, let’s share this company and maybe if they have enough growth the hours could expand. At least for weekend emergencies or questions.
reviews.author: Becky Cunneen

reviews.text: I called because my pool looked like a swamp.  Clayton was here the same day and told me exactly what was needed.  They came out, drained the pool, power washed it and made it like brand new.  They also did this for hundreds less than what the competition quoted us.  From the initial phone call to the after care and follow up questions I had I was treated like a VIP.  I highly recommend A better pool service and will not call anyone else as long as I have a pool.
